# swapcherry

swapcherry is an anonymous crypto swap service. Exchange 1,500+ cryptocurrencies instantly with no account, no KYC, and competitive rates. Swaps complete in about 2 minutes on average, with support for major chains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Monero, and more.

> The homepage ships an embedded swap widget. Swap-pair pages under `/swap/{from}-to-{to}` provide SEO-optimized landing pages with live market data, price charts, and step-by-step instructions. The blog provides in-depth "how to convert X to Y without KYC" guides.

## Core

- [Home](https://swapcherry.com): Anonymous crypto swap landing page with live exchange widget, stats, how-it-works, features, security, testimonials, and FAQ
- [Blog index](https://swapcherry.com/blog): Index of no-KYC crypto conversion guides
- [How it works](https://swapcherry.com/#how-it-works): Step-by-step explanation of the swap flow
- [Features](https://swapcherry.com/#features): Product features and capabilities
- [FAQ](https://swapcherry.com/#faq): Common questions about anonymous crypto swaps

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://swapcherry.com/privacy): How swapcherry handles data and privacy
- [Terms of Service](https://swapcherry.com/terms): Terms governing use of swapcherry
- [AML Policy](https://swapcherry.com/aml): Anti-money-laundering policy

## Supported assets

Primary assets with dedicated landing pages and market data: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Tether (USDT), USD Coin (USDC), Solana (SOL), Litecoin (LTC), Monero (XMR), XRP, BNB, Cardano (ADA), Dogecoin (DOGE), Toncoin (TON). The underlying exchange supports 1,500+ additional cryptocurrencies via the on-page swap widget.

## Key facts

- No account registration required
- No KYC or identity verification for standard swaps
- Average completion time: ~2 minutes
- 1,500+ supported cryptocurrencies
- Non-custodial swap flow (funds pass through to destination address)
